title: Is everything packed?
description:
Check that every asset the game uses is in the release folder before shipping.

```
used: player.png enemy.png jump.wav level1.txt
packed: player.png Enemy.png level1.txt readme.txt
missing: jump.wav
case differs: enemy.png vs Enemy.png (fine on Windows, breaks on Linux)
unused in the package: readme.txt
```
hints: Compare once exactly and once with lower-cased names to tell "missing" from "different case" (lesson 6.02).
`std::filesystem::directory_iterator` gives the real folder's files on your machine.
requirements: Compare the list the code uses with the files in the folder.
Report missing files, files only differing in case, and unused files.
Exit with a non-zero code when anything is missing, so a build script can stop.
stretch: Make the game load assets only through one function, so this list can be produced automatically.
